title: cremanthodium campanulatum
intro: Cremanthodium campanulatum, commonly known as the Himalayan daisy, is a flowering plant species in the family Compositae. It is native to the Himalayas and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Cremanthodium campanulatum have been found to have potential health benefits, including anti-cancer and neuroprotective effects.
